queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Portuguese first-party discovery identified SEDUH's public GeoPortal, the Parcelamentos do Solo portal listing RA-XV, and the IDE-DF Cadastro Territorial ArcGIS service. Layer 10 (Lotes Registrados) was inspected, its schema and CRS recorded, exact WUP-point queries returned zero features, and a bounded pu_ra=15 query returned three anonymous ID-plus-geometry features.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-15.912555703767, -48.0696353880458] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The sample contains at most three polygons and each feature properties object contains exactly one canonical native identity field: id.
Native source attributes, source field mapping, and administrative filter provenance are documented here and in the city record, not retained in GeoJSON properties.
No raw owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or registration fields were requested or retained.
No registry/catalog/runtime configuration, global report, queue ledger, or another city's file was changed.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.

qualification.reason: A real public local Distrito Federal registered-lot polygon layer and stable native OID were verified, but independent serial adapter qualification remains required.

uncertainty: The official Lotes Registrados layer may not represent the complete legal cadastral or title registry fabric. Exact-point nonintersection is local evidence only; the three-feature bounded sample does not establish citywide completeness or currentness.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for independent serial review and adapter qualification against the IDE-DF Cadastro Territorial layer; do not treat this packet as source integration/admission.
